items.title: Can HCA Healthcare (HCA) Overcome Healthcare’s Margin Pressures?
items.summary: On September 22, BMO Capital analyst Sean Dodge initiated coverage of HCA Healthcare, Inc. (NYSE:HCA) with an Outperform rating and a $495 price target. items.title: Can Shorter Hospital Stays Help HCA Handle More Patient Demand?
items.summary: HCA's rising admissions and shorter hospital stays could help it meet growing patient demand while using existing capacity more efficiently.

items.title: 3 Large-Cap Stocks with Solid Fundamentals
items.summary: Large-cap stocks usually command their industries because they have the scale to drive market trends. The flip side though is that their sheer size can limit growth as expanding further becomes an increasingly challenging task.

items.title: HCA Healthcare (HCA) Shares Moved, What Is Driving Attention Today?
items.summary: HCA Healthcare (HCA) is back in focus after five affiliated Texas hospitals filed suit against Independence Blue Cross, alleging more than $345,000 in unpaid claims between 2022 and 2024. At a share price of US$438.12, HCA Healthcare has seen a 2.85% 1 day share price return and a 12.99% 90 day share price return.
